title: Preview video generation with Veo and Seedance
summary:
Preview video generation and richer community chat led the day, while the site got clearer about the people building on it.

Preview video generation was added to the prompt route with Veo 3.1 Fast and Seedance. Both return MP4 files; Seedance also accepts an image as input. Requests can set duration, aspect ratio, and audio, and Enter now shows per-second video pricing.

The community chat app gained session controls for the system prompt, max tokens, temperature, and top-p. It can render charts in messages and show streamed reasoning in a collapsible panel, alongside a tidier sidebar and layout.

Website and documentation copy now emphasizes open development and 500+ community projects. Project listings gained refreshed descriptions and a corrected ReThink AI link.

daily.title: Veo video generation
daily.text: Generate preview MP4 videos with `veo` (`veo-3.1-fast`). Choose a 4-, 6-, or 8-second duration. [View Veo](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=veo).

daily.title: Seedance image-to-video
daily.text: Generate preview MP4 videos with `seedance`, including from an input image. [View Seedance](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedance).

daily.title: Charts in community chat
daily.text: The community chat app can render bar, line, pie, and scatter charts in messages, including streamed chart responses.

daily.title: Chat sessions, your settings
daily.text: Set a system prompt, max tokens, temperature, and top-p for a chat session. Streamed reasoning now appears in a collapsible panel.
